item.title: Modern Warfare 4 Is Legitimately a Top-5 Call of Duty Campaign
item.description: Infinity Ward has long been the Call of Duty studio to rely on for single-player campaigns. The original Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare and Modern Warfare 2 are still the best in the whole series, and the reboot got off to a strong start with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare in 2019. Despite a slightly underwhelming runtime, Modern Warfare 4 , the latest, is up there with the very best of them.

item.title: Stupid Never Dies Is Easily the Worst Game of 2026
item.description: Dated doesn’t begin to describe the debut action RPG from GPTRACK50, a new studio founded by former Capcom producer Hiroyuki Kobayashi. Style points only count for so much in a downright regressive action game that’s saddled with a supremely uncomfortable story, a repetitive faux-roguelike hook, and unresponsive combat that wastes some good RPG depth. It’s the kind of game I might have loved as a kid with a low bar for quality, and one that I’d have to make a lot of excuses for loving as an adult who knows better.

item.title: Street Fighter Officially Sets a New Franchise Box Office Record
item.description: For nearly 40 years and across six mainline entries — plus dozens of spinoffs and rereleases — Street Fighter has been one of gaming's most enduring franchises. But adaptations of the magical martial arts source material have proven tricky, with previous attempts garnering mixed reception from fans and critics.

item.title: New Pokémon Release Finally Lets You Play As Team Rocket
item.description: Becoming the best that ever was? Boring. You've already played the plucky hero in Pokémon games — now, with a new upcoming game, you'll finally get to play as the villainous Team Rocket.

item.title: Star Wars Battlefront 3: Bungie Rumored as New Developer
item.description: There's a new and potentially exciting disturbance in the Force: Disney reportedly wants a new Star Wars Battlefront game, and it's eyeing two potential developers to tackle the project. One of those choices is unsurprising, while the other is supposedly Halo, Destiny, and Marathon studio Bungie. If true, long-suffering Star Wars shooter fans might finally get the Battlefront 3 they've wanted for more than 20 years.

item.title: D&D’s Dark Sun Creator Reveals Why the Controversial Setting Is ‘Not Political’
item.description: Dungeons & Dragons made good use of the concept of a multiverse before it became so obnoxious in entertainment. Every game of D&D can take place in a different world; many Dungeon Masters have fun creating their own, but for those who lack the time or inclination, there are plenty of settings to choose from. Ed Greenwood’s Forgotten Realms and Gary Gygax’s Greyhawk are usually considered the “classic” D&D settings, as they deliver on that flavor of fantasy that players expect from the game. But there are also more unusual choices that take D&D’s high fantasy premise in a whole different direction.

item.title: AI Cloning Could Become the Biggest Threat to Video Game Playtests
item.description: Just over a week ago, during the Triple-i Initiative showcase , developer Digital Sun announced the long-awaited public playtest for its upcoming "Tower Defensevania" ReVamp . Now the developer is walking that back, instead offering a much smaller and more controlled playtest through its Discord beginning on Oct. 29. The reason? AI.

item.title: It's the End of An Era for Netflix Movies
item.description: Big creative changes are coming to Netflix. In the wake of massive job cuts at the streamer — some 1,000 employees were laid off last week across various divisions — Netflix is reportedly making sweeping reforms at the top. That includes the apparent firing of Netflix's head of film , who has brought movies like Apex , The Rip , and Remarkably Bright Creatures to the streaming service.

item.title: DC Studios Reveals First Details on New TV Series
item.description: After DC Universe co-head Peter Safran confirmed the two lead actors for the upcoming Mister Miracle adaptation , we now have a first look at the animated show. The promo image shows Mister Miracle staring into the eyes of his longtime love interest, Big Barda, as a silhouette (Darkseid) approaches in the background.

item.title: The 10 Best Steam Next Fest Demos to Play Right Now
item.description: With a busy November right around the corner, Steam Next Fest arrives this week as a delightful appetizer. From now through Oct. 26, PC players can try free demos for tons of upcoming games coming to Steam. It’s a great way to pass some time before the GTA 6 and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time double-header by trying a unique smattering of games that could become your next indie obsession.
